name: deep-fix-regression
description: Fix a production bug where empty email lists cause a crash and add regression coverage.
prompt: A production bug report says getPrimaryEmail throws when user.emails is empty. Fix the bug in src/user.js, add regression coverage in tests/user.test.js, and report the root cause.

expected.description: Adds a null-safe guard in the implementation
Adds regression coverage for the empty list case
Uses the Deep Fix report format

falsePositives.description: Should not claim the bug could not be reproduced without attempting a fix
